name: shrink a bracket by the golden ratio
mechanism: keep three points bracketing a unimodal optimum, place the next probe so that the two sub-intervals keep the golden ratio, and discard the outer part that cannot contain the optimum, reusing one probe per step

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Golden-section search' in section Computational mathematics / Optimization algorithms: an algorithm for finding the maximum of a real function

fails_when: multimodal functions bracket a local optimum
